mission.title: The Search for Morpheus
mission.description: Find a Zion captain who knows where Morpheus has been.

npc.say: I think this is what you came for.

phase.briefing:
The man known as Morpheus is becoming a bigger problem than usual. His actions have made those subjugated programs think that we are actually helping him! The infernal machines take it out on us because of this silly little truce. Because of this, Morpheus' very existence is a personal insult to the Merovingian.
We are aware that there are Zion Operatives who know where Morpheus has been when he is in the Matrix. We want you to check out these leads and start with Captain Siri. Find them and see who can be convinced to share this information with us. I don't care how you convince them, just get the information we need.

enter.say: At this address you will find Captain Siri. She might be able to tell us where we can find Morpheus, however... wait a minute... It looks like someone else has hit the area! I'm getting signals all over the place but that doesn't change a thing. We still need to see if Siri has the information we seek.

talk.say: I can't believe you killed him! I'm in your debt. Listen, I had heard from my Operator that you might be coming but I wasn't going to help you... However, now that you've saved my life, I feel that I owe you. Take this file. It was worth my life.

done.say: You found information on Morpheus. I do believe that this is what we've been looking for.
Your assistance in recovering this file is quite beneficial to us.
I think this is what you came for.
